design: Only max-age ineligibility with original validity and arithmetic TTL still valid may proceed to a new check; old prior stays absent.
The exact native age refusal includes drs_temporal_hard_gate_failed and drs_required_evidence_missing because this query requires TIME_FITNESS. Every other native eligibility gate must pass.
The existing public cold trust contract requires actual additional typed PURE Work, then a fresh Root decision and actual selected Work. No new observation or usable history is manufactured.
The optional history-only control clock cannot go backwards or open eligible history. Actual current Root and Work keep the current controller clock.
Real-time aged history enters the same branch without the control argument. Expired, conflict, quarantine and other refusal reasons continue to stop before Work.
History snapshots hash only HEAD, writer lock and exact epoch/descriptor/payload/DRS files named by this instance retained live captures; they reconstruct no authority.
No history outcome references are reported as consumed when no history was opened.

io_changes.reads: Finite retained native history files, at most eight live captured epochs; each file <=1048576 bytes.
io_changes.writes: Existing immutable evidence persistence, plus aged_consumer_control report; no history mutation.

limitations: Control clock does not assert 300 seconds of actual elapsed wall time.
This source proposal does not accept Stage05 or the owner scenario.
Old v01 evidence, reviews, pins, admission and reservation are unchanged.

Confirm genuine unrelated controller and actual source revision scenarios use history_snapshot only as byte evidence.
